findings: Serving model loads once and stays on GPU; no per-request reload.
Default sampling still shows different median pitch across these two paragraphs.
Current sampling yields closer pitch medians on this pair, so this run does not establish that custom sampling causes timbre drift.
Pitch processing shifts both current samples about 2.5 semitones; perceptual effect remains for listening.
Local default inference remains much slower than remote for the same text.
limits: One batch per condition, two full chapters from an earlier real podcast.
No manual listening, ASR, or speaker-similarity evaluation. Pitch is not timbre.
Cloud has a different model and voice; this is not an isolated model-size comparison.
Official and custom sampling consume randomness differently.
No new inference backend benchmark; FlashAttention 2 is absent, SDPA is active.
